findings.title: Application ships two divergent dependency declarations for requests
findings.note: pay-service is a deployed app (Docker/CI install via requirements.txt), yet pyproject.toml carries its own unpinned floating requests range with no lockfile, while requirements.txt separately pins an exact version actually used to build/test.

open_questions.question: Is pyproject.toml's dependency list actually used for any install path, or is requirements.txt the sole real source of truth (making the pyproject entry dead metadata)?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: setup.py is a no-op shim deferring to pyproject.toml, not a competing build system; not a dependency-duplication finding.

not_assessed: Whether requests 2.32.3 or the >=2.31 range has any known CVEs
Whether requests is end-of-life or currently maintained
Whether the version mismatch has caused an actual runtime incident
